comparables.source: GAPKI Indonesia palm oil land transaction reports 2024

methodology:
PT Astra Agro Lestari is one of Indonesia's largest palm oil operators with ~287K hectares (~709K acres) across Sumatra, Kalimantan, and Sulawesi. Reports in IDR.

Indonesian palm oil land FMVs translated to IDR: $5K USD/acre × IDR 16,000/USD = ~IDR 80M/acre for mature Sumatra estates with mill access. Kalimantan/Sulawesi cluster slightly lower due to logistics distance from major ports.

The per-acre IDR figures look astronomical to non-Indonesian readers but are consistent with the underlying USD-based palm oil land economics.
